pages.name: Morgan Vale
pages.summary: Operations Manager at Tidewater Ferry Authority; lives in Eastbrook; owns Larkspur Holdings LLC.
pages.body:
- Operations Manager at Tidewater Ferry Authority. Teaches the Saturday deckhand course at Marlow Maritime School (no calls before noon Saturdays).
- Lives in Eastbrook. Spouse: Riley Vale. Children: Juno and Felix. Mother: Anne Vale. Allergic to shellfish.
- Dogs: Biscuit and Pepper. Drives a 2019 Subaru Outback (traded the CR-V in June 2026).
- Holding company: Larkspur Holdings LLC. Software company: Larkspur Works LLC. Owns half of Quarry Road Partners LLC with Dana Okafor.
- DISPUTED: which entity holds Morgan's half of Quarry Road Partners (operating agreement says Larkspur Holdings LLC; Granite Savings loan papers say Larkspur Cabins LLC). Ask Morgan which entity to name on any legal, tax or bank document.
- Heron Cabin hot tub coverage under the Alder Mutual policy is unresolved. Ask Morgan before telling anyone it is covered.
- Accountant: Priya Shah at Shah & Lowe since August 2026 (was Leo Marsh). Attorney: Tom Brandt, Brandt Law (LLC filings). Physician: Dr. Lena Ortiz, Eastbrook Family Practice. Umbrella policy: Keystone. Gym: Harbor Athletic Club since October 2026.
- 100-ton master license expires May 1, 2027. TWIC card expires August 30, 2028.
- Sign formal documents "Morgan A. Vale", casual notes "Mo". No em dashes in anything public. Reports: 400 words max, answer first.
- Holiday on-call roster: sources disagree. One says Morgan covers Christmas Day; another says Sam Whitlock covers Christmas Day and Morgan covers New Year's Day.

pages.name: Tidewater Ferry Authority
pages.summary: Ferry operator where Morgan is Operations Manager.
pages.body:
- Morgan Vale is Operations Manager. Ines Calder is Harbor Master. Dana Reyes is Finance Director. Sam Whitlock is deputy operations manager (since September 2026). Bea Lindqvist is union steward for the deck crews.
- Fleet: MV Osprey (mornings, main route), MV Tern (afternoons, main route), MV Kestrel (spare boat).
- Winter schedule cuts the last evening sailing on weekdays.
- Ticket office opens 5:30 on weekdays. Fuel deliveries to the dock are Wednesdays.
- Weekly ops meeting moved to Tuesdays at 7:30 in October 2026.
- Morgan's terminal parking is spot A4 (was B12).
- Coast Guard annual inspection for the MV Osprey is due February 12, 2027.

pages.name: Heron Cabin
pages.summary: Short-term rental in Pine Hollow, Vermont, owned by Larkspur Cabins LLC.
pages.body:
- Owned by Larkspur Cabins LLC; in Pine Hollow, Vermont; listed through Staylark (host fee 15% since October 1, 2026, was 12%).
- Sleeps eight in three bedrooms. Check-in 4pm, check-out 10am.
- Base rate $285 a night as of September 2026. Minimum stay two nights, three on holiday weekends, since September 2026.
- Internet: Greenline Fiber since May 2026 (was Pinecone Wireless). Hot tub: Summit Pools (was ClearSpa, which closed).
- Operating account at Northfield Credit Union (moved in 2026; was Granite Savings).
- Insured with Alder Mutual; renews January 15.
- Cleaner: Marisol Peña. Plumbing: Hale Plumbing. Driveway plowing: Dunmore Plowing. Firewood delivered by the cord in October.
- Hot tub coverage under the Alder Mutual policy is unresolved: the agent said yes by phone, the policy wording excludes it. Ask Morgan before telling anyone it is covered.
